name: Tsuki no Kanata de Aimashou: SweetSummerRainbow
original_name: 月の彼方で逢いましょう SweetSummerRainbow
source:
——As lovers.
It's been one year since the protagonist and Rein met. It's now the spring of their third year at school.

For the first time, they're in the same class, in adjacent seats. Everyday is a chain of new and blissful events, keeping their hearts racing from their "first love".

And now, it's the summer holidays. The two of them are going to attend summer school; it's being held is San Francisco... where Rein was born... her homeland.

An unexpected event results in the two of them sharing a room, bringing their "fresh and innocent" limited-time cohabitation life to a start———

——As husband and wife.
The protagonist and Rein have married and have set out as husband and wife. Between them was born their beloved daughter.

It's quite a lot of work raising a kid, but she returns to them an even greater share of happiness.

Their precious family is always by their sides. Their precious friends are always watching over them. And that's why they can keep walking looking straight ahead.

"Darling... I want a second one soon"

This is a story packed with such "exasperating amounts of happiness" and "being moved by one's family".

[Translated from [url=http://toneworks.product.co.jp/ssr/index.html]tone work's official site[/url].]
translation:
——身為戀人。
主角與雨音相遇，已經過去了一年。如今，是兩人升入三年級的春天。

他們第一次被分到同一個班，座位也在隔壁。每天都有新鮮而幸福的事情接連發生，「初戀」的悸動讓兩人始終心跳不已。

轉眼，暑假到了。兩人即將參加暑期學校，舉辦地點是舊金山……那裡是雨音的出生地……是她的故鄉。

一場意料之外的變故，讓兩人住進了同一個房間。他們「青澀而純真」的限時同居生活，就此拉開帷幕——

——身為夫妻。
主角與雨音結了婚，攜手踏上夫妻共同的人生旅程。兩人心愛的女兒也降生了。

養育孩子雖然十分辛苦，但她帶來的幸福遠比辛勞更多。

珍愛的家人始終陪伴身旁，珍重的朋友始終守望著他們。正因如此，他們才能目視前方，一直走下去。

「親愛的……我想早點再要一個孩子。」

這是一個滿載著「幸福得讓人嫉妒」和「家人帶來的感動」的故事。

[譯自[url=http://toneworks.product.co.jp/ssr/index.html]tone work's官方網站[/url]。]
